name: Force of Negation
oracle_text:
If it's not your turn, you may exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Counter target noncreature spell. If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.
blocked_sentences: If it's not your turn, you may exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
If that spell is countered this way, exile it instead of putting it into its owner's graveyard.

needs.what: a cost key that exiles a card from the payer's hand chosen by a selector (here: a blue card other than this spell), payable as a card-level `alternative_cost` -- which means `alternative_cost` must also be able to charge something other than mana. Today the loader restricts `alternative_cost` to exactly {`mana`, `condition`} and hard-requires `mana` (src/automtg/cards/loader.py:1205-1228), so even a new exile-from-hand cost key would have nowhere on the card to live. Both halves are needed for the whole 'pitch' family: Force of Will, Force of Negation, Misdirection, Commandeer, the Modern Horizons free elementals.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `cost_keys` carries `discard_selector`, which picks a hand card by exactly this kind of filter but sends it to the graveyard rather than exile -- a visible rules difference (graveyard recursion, delirium, threshold) that makes it an approximation, not the printed cost. The only exile costs are `exile_self` (the source, which here is the spell being cast) and `exile_from_graveyard` (wrong zone). `card_level_cost_keys` has `alternative_cost`, but its validator accepts no payment except a mana string, and `evoke`/`madness`/`overload` are likewise bare mana prices. The 'If it's not your turn' half is NOT the blocker: `alternative_cost.condition` already exists and `condition_keys` has `is_your_turn` and `not`.

needs.what: an option on the `counter` op -- e.g. `to: "exile"` -- that sends the countered spell to exile instead of its owner's graveyard, applying only to spells this instance actually countered ('countered this way'). Wanted by Force of Negation, Dissipate, Void Shatter, Nullify-style exile counters and Hindering Light's cousins.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `op_counter` (src/automtg/engine/effects/ops_stack.py:223) unconditionally calls `move_object(..., Zone.GRAVEYARD, cause="countered")` after pulling the item off the stack; the spec accepts only `target`/`sid` and there is no destination key. Chaining `exile` after `counter` cannot reach it either: once countered the spell is no longer a stack object, and `selector_keys` has no way to name the card that a preceding `counter` in the same effect list just moved -- `snapshot` reads a value off an object, not a zone-change replacement. `replace_leaves_battlefield` and `replace_deaths` are battlefield-only and would not see a stack-to-graveyard move.
